list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Dodecameric cerium(IV) cluster stabilized by silicotungstate and acetate ligands

material_class.structural_family: cerium(IV) oxo-hydroxo cluster supported by two [SiW9O34] polyoxometalates and acetate ligands

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Compound 1 contains a dodecameric cerium cluster assembled from two hexameric Ce6 units linked by two μ4-oxo bridges. Two [SiW9O34] units coordinate the cerium cluster, while acetate ligands occupy the opposite side; the two crystallographically independent moieties differ in acetate coordination/disorder.

synthesis.procedure: Cerium was used in excess (approximately 4.5 equivalents relative to the POM unit) in acetate buffer. Crystallization produced an initial Ce4 sandwich phase after 1–2 days, followed by crystals of compound 1 after approximately two months; formation was reported to be erratic.

reagents.amount: approximately 4.5 equivalents relative to the POM unit
reagents.name: cerium(IV) reagent

synthesis.time: Initial crystallization after 1–2 days; compound 1 crystallized after approximately two months
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals formed by prolonged crystallization from the reaction mixture; the first phase was a previously reported Ce4 sandwich, with compound 1 appearing after about two months.

title: Synthesis of a large dodecameric cerium cluster stabilized by the [SiW9O34] polyoxometalate
